why: Severs the session's renderer from the identity marker, so every arena ring is the solid hue-only ring: an unflagged FFA match loses the `shape` marker that ships as its default (issue #922), and `?dev=1&identityMarker=shape` still parses, validates and reports as accepted in the developer pane while changing nothing on screen. Invisible to every test of the marker geometry and of the resolver, neither of which goes through loop.ts. Killed by the threads-the-identityMarker-dev-flag case, which asserts every style rather than one, and by the #922 cases that boot an FFA session from the setup pane and from the URL.
